triage.source: PROVISIONAL, not clinically validated: parasitized >= 1 is a model-prediction review flag, not confirmed parasite detection; uninfected >= 1000 AND parasitized == 0 is an unsupported thin-smear normal-screen rule. NLM's configurable 1000-cell capture target is software provenance only (https://github.com/LHNCBC/MalariaScreener/blob/c485a21/app/src/main/java/gov/nih/nlm/malaria_screener/camera/CameraActivity.java#L151). WHO MM-SOP-08 section 4.2 requires at least 100 high-power fields before a THICK film is reported with no parasites seen (https://www.who.int/docs/default-source/wpro---documents/toolkit/malaria-sop/gmp-sop-08-revised.pdf); this does not validate our thin-smear rule. WHO MM-SOP-09 section 4.2 describes about 20 fields / 5000 RBCs for thin-film parasite counting, not negative screening (https://www.who.int/docs/default-source/wpro---documents/toolkit/malaria-sop/gmp-sop-09-revised.pdf). Also PROVISIONAL: aggregation.min_fields=1, uncertainty.band=[0.5,0.65], uncertainty.max_fraction=0.05, quality.min_blur=8.0 and quality.max_clipped_fraction=0.45. No applicable clinical validation for these automated settings was identified in the reviewed protocols; see README.md#threshold-evidence-issue-7 for evidence and checks needed.

provenance.source: NLM Malaria Screener's Sudan-retrained thin-smear CNN, malaria_thinsmear_44_retrainSudan_20P_4000C_separate.pb: the model the NLM app loads (CameraActivity.java line 277, https://github.com/LHNCBC/MalariaScreener commit c485a21). Converted from TensorFlow to ONNX with tf2onnx 1.17.0; parity with the original graph is UNVERIFIED (see README).
provenance.licence: UNVERIFIED: the root LICENSE is BSD-style with NLM attribution, but 85+ source files carry GPLv3 headers and the weights have no licence or provenance file (docs/spikes/S1-malaria-screener.md). Weights stay out of git until resolved.
training_data: UNVERIFIED: not documented by NLM; the file name suggests retraining on 20 patients / 4000 cells, possibly from Sudan
provenance.notes: Chosen for the demo because NLM pairs it with this segmentation; replace it after measurement on annotated field images. quality is PROVISIONAL, from 8 RBCNet fields (5312x2988): QualityGate blur 12.8-15.8 and 33-37% exactly-black pixels from the eyepiece vignette; uncertainty values are PLACEHOLDERS from the contract example. model.onnx is malaria_thin_44_sudan.onnx with its final Softmax removed (ml/tools/onnx_logits.py): ClassifierDecoder applies softmax itself. Logit 0 is parasitized (TensorFlowClassifier.recongnize_batch), so labels are [parasitized, uninfected].
